name: Systemic
test: Affects the boundary, a Capability/Outcome definition, or two or more gates

name: Critical
test: Affects a gate-critical control or a gate criterion (CG-12 trigger)
decisionEffect: Gate -> UNKNOWN; decision <= LIMITED or INCONCLUSIVE per gate ceiling

name: Material
test: Could change a control result or a decision condition but no gate

name: Moderate
test: Affects confidence but not any result
decisionEffect: Confidence ceiling CONF-2 for affected claims

name: Low
test: No plausible effect on any result or condition
